reason: The plugin primarily integrates DSH web/API access with remote exposure, authentication gating, privileged endpoint access, and local native folder selection; its remote-access and passwordless-default behavior warrants human review.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web/API 提供远程访问认证门禁、特权接口放行以及本机原生工作区目录选择功能。
summaries.en: Adds remote access authentication, enables authenticated access to privileged DSH Web/API endpoints, and provides native local workspace folder selection.

capabilities: Exposes the DSH web server for remote access
Adds password-based authentication for non-loopback HTTP/API requests
Enables access to loopback-restricted and privileged DSH endpoints after authentication
Patches server behavior and restores it on plugin removal
Invokes native operating-system folder pickers for local workspace selection
